name: Deal Scout
tagline: Trawls resale sites for genuinely underpriced second-hand finds and skips the scams
description: It searches the big resale marketplaces in one pass instead of one at a time, then filters what comes back. Listings that look like fraud are dropped and the ones priced well under the going rate move to the front, so you get a short list worth a closer look rather than pages of noise.
author: danielhayesmith
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
